title: Karl Nell's revised Kardashev scale

tellings.quote: Carl Nell, who set up Army Futures Command and was, you know, um, kind of defending Grush publicly as soon as he came out and and, uh, was on the UAP task force. He talks about a different version of the Cardesev scale.

plain: An Army officer named Karl Nell has proposed his own version of the Kardashev scale, a way of ranking civilizations by how much energy they can harness. Michels brings this up himself in passing. He describes Nell as someone who helped set up Army Futures Command, the Army's command for modernizing its forces, and who served on the UAP task force, a Pentagon group that studied unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. He adds that Nell publicly defended a man named David Grusch "as soon as he came out" with his claims, but he does not say what Nell's revised scale actually contains.
